_comment: Shipped project settings. Paths are project-relative (a leading / in a permission rule means the project root, not the filesystem root) so this file works on any machine — it previously hardcoded one contributor's D:/ drive and was inert everywhere else. MCP servers are configured separately in .mcp.json at the project root, which is where Claude Code requires project-scope MCPs to live.

permissions._comment: Least privilege for a plugin a stranger installs. Deliberately absent: `Bash(git commit*)` and `Bash(git add*)` (a research pipeline has no business pre-approving commits) and a bare `WebFetch` (analysts fetch attacker-influenced pages; that prompt should be seen). Add those to your own .claude/settings.local.json if you want them.
